data.title: Bangkok halts new data centre approvals
data.description: No more licences will be issued for new data centres in Bangkok, governor Chadchart Sittipunt said on Wednesday, responding to growing concerns about potential negative impacts associated with the facilities.

data.title: Passenger voices fear over 'ghost mask’ inside ride-hail car
data.description: A ride-hail passenger took to social media to raise concerns over safety after an unsettling experience in which they found a frightening human-like mask inside the vehicle.

data.title: Mpox, Covid-19 cases continue to rise
data.description: New cases of Mpox and Covid-19 continue to rise since June with the presence of a severer mpox strain and a low fatality rate for Covid-19, according to the Department of Disease Control.

data.title: Khao Kheow Open Zoo to celebrate beloved hippo Mae Mali's 61st birthday
data.description: CHON BURI -Khao Kheow Open Zoo has prepared a special celebration for much-loved Mae Mali, or Mother Mali, Thailand’s oldest hippopotamus, as she marks her 61st birthday on Sept 8.

data.title: Cabinet decides to change location of Korat floral expo
data.description: The Cabinet has agreed to change the venue for an international floral exhibition in Nakhon Ratchasima, a decision that has shocked residents.

data.title: US aircraft carrier approaches Thai port after months at sea
data.description: LAEM CHABANG — A US aircraft carrier at the centre of controversy over conditions on board approached the Thai coast on Wednesday for its first port call in nine months.

data.title: Chinese arrested for illegal travel from Cambodia to Malaysia via Thailand
data.description: CHUMPHON: Highway police arrested five Chinese men and two Thais for carrying no legal travel documents, in this southern province on Saturday night.

data.title: After over 200 days at sea, US aircraft carrier arrives in Thailand
data.description: LAEM CHABANG, ​Chon Buri - ⁠US Navy aircraft carrier Abraham ​Lincoln steamed into Thailand's Laem Chabang deep-sea port on Wednesday morning ​after more than 200 days ‌at sea, including a long deployment in the Middle East, amid reports of mental health concerns and deteriorating conditions aboard.

data.title: German suspect faces extradition
data.description: Mae Hong Son: The Immigration Bureau (IB) has arrested a German man wanted in his country for assaulting and obstructing a public official, after he allegedly evaded arrest for more than three years.

data.title: Probe urged for TH-AI passport deal
data.description: <p>People's Party MP Rukchanok Srinork and technology expert Theerachart Kortrakul yesterday petitioned the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) to investigate alleged irregularities in the 1.6-billion-baht TH-AI Passport project.</p>

data.title: Singapore PM in town for official visit
data.description: <p>Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong arrived in Thailand today for an official visit and the fifth Thailand-Singapore Leaders' Retreat.</p>

data.title: Dept opens low-carbon learning hub
data.description: <p>The Department of Climate Change and Environment (DCCE) has opened a Low-Carbon School Learning Centre in Phuket to expand environmental education and support the shift to a low-carbon society as part of its efforts.</p>

data.title: Rice-growing areas shrinking
data.description: <p>Southern rice growers and millers warn of mounting food-security risks as rice-growing areas shrink rapidly and farmers switch to oil palm because of high costs, low yields, and weak returns.</p>

data.title: Diggers 'damaging ancient burial sites'
data.description: <p>PHETCHABUN: Authorities have found more than 200 pits at an archaeological site in Wichian Buri district, where illegal digging appears to have disturbed prehistoric graves and scattered human and animal remains.</p>

data.title: Satun gets 30 days to study seaplane base
data.description: <p>SATUN: The Transport Ministry has given Satun authorities 30 days to report on the feasibility of a state-run seaplane landing facility to serve Koh Lipe and other Andaman destinations.</p>

data.title: 'Vessel collision' kills whale
data.description: <p>A post-mortem examination has found that a Bryde's whale that washed ashore in Samut Prakan died from severe injuries to its head and upper jaw, believed to have been caused by a collision with a vessel, the Department of Marine and Coastal Resources said.</p>

data.title: Grey capital crackdown widens beyond Bangkok
data.description: <p>Authorities are intensifying a crackdown on suspected nominee businesses and "grey capital", with about 14,000 companies nationwide under further investigation, Deputy Interior Minister Polapee Suwunchwee said.</p>

data.title: Youth hit hard as total HIV cases exceed 500,000
data.description: <p>Thailand has recorded more than 500,000 cumulative HIV infections, with 13 provinces reporting more than 10,000 cases each, according to fiscal 2026 data.</p>

data.title: Govt to face twin debates
data.description: <p>The opposition is set to submit both a general debate and a no-confidence motion against the government, despite it having been in office for only five months, citing mounting problems in several areas, according to an opposition whip.</p>

data.title: Man arrested with 880,000 speed pills at Isan resort
data.description: SAKON NAKHON - A man arrested with 880,000 methamphetamine pills at a resort in Waritchaphum district in this northeastern province has confessed to trafficking the narcotics from Laos, authorities said on Tuesday.

data.title: Cabinet approves double-track rail expansion
data.description: The cabinet has approved six railway projects under the second phase of double-track expansion, with three southern line projects receiving full funding worth 106.7 billion baht.

data.title: Home tele-rehab system completes Thai trials
data.description: Chulalongkorn University researchers have completed trials of an AI and augmented reality rehabilitation system that lets patients with balance disorders train at home under remote specialist monitoring.

data.title: Health coverage law changes face backlash
data.description: Civil society groups have come out against proposed changes to the universal healthcare law, warning the amendments could erode rights to public health coverage.

data.title: New body to turn education research into policy
data.description: The problems with reforming education may lie less in a lack of research, funding or expertise than in a failure to get evidence into policy and the classroom, the Equitable Education Fund (EEF) says.

data.title: Dissevered body scattered along train tracks in Hat Yai
data.description: SONGKHLA - The dissevered body of a 62-year-old Myanmar man was found scattered along the railway track under the Lopburi Ramesuan twin bridges in Hat Yai, Songkhla, on Monday evening.

data.title: Five fluffy new arrivals join Khon Kaen Zoo’s flamingo flock
data.description: KHON KAEN - Khon Kaen Zoo is celebrating the successful hatching of five greater flamingo chicks, marking another step in its efforts to strengthen wildlife breeding and conservation programmes.

data.title: Brothers linked to Australia-bound ‘ice’ shipments
data.description: NAKHON SI THAMMARAT - Two Thai brothers were arrested on Tuesday for alleged involvement in a Rayong-based drug smuggling network that used tourist boats to ferry their illegal Australia-bound cargo.
